cohort: 108 reproductive-age women with uterine abnormalities such as recurrent pregnancy loss, abnormal uterine bleeding, infertility, and clinically diagnosed lesions of intrauterine at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology of Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences, Jamshoro.
finding: Hysterosonography had a specificity of 94%, sensitivity of 77%, and positive predictive value of 74% for diagnosing uterine lesions compared to hysteroscopy.
